partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Airways and Hamad International Airport jointly launched the Fast Pass biometric travel service, indicating an operational collaboration to deploy shared facial recognition infrastructure at the airport for Qatar Airways passengers.

press_references.value: Qatar Airways, Philippine Airlines strengthen partnership, expand markets

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Airways and Philippine Airlines will deepen their existing codeshare by June 1, 2026, adding QR codes on PAL domestic services and PR codes on Qatar Airways flights from Philippine cities to Doha and onward to over 20 European destinations, while also launching a reciprocal loyalty partnership between Privilege Club and Mabuhay Miles.

press_references.value: Qatar well-prepared to ensure steady availability of essential goods: Minister

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar's Ministry of Commerce and Industry has coordinated with Qatar Airways in a partnership to facilitate urgent air shipments of essential commodities into the country, already delivering over 300 tonnes with a target of 1,000 tonnes.

press_references.value: Qatar Airways Partners with Michelin One-Star Filipino Chef Jordy and May Navarra to Launch an Exclusive Business Class Menu

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Airways announced a new culinary partnership with Manila’s Michelin-starred Toyo Eatery team led by Chef Jordy and May Navarra to design an exclusive Business Class menu for flights between Manila and Doha.

press_references.value: Qatar, US issue joint statement on seventh strategic dialogue

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Airways announced a commercial aircraft procurement partnership with Boeing and GE Aerospace through a $96 billion deal to acquire up to 210 Boeing 787 Dreamliner and 777X aircraft powered by GE engines.

press_references.value: Qatar Airways claims Starlink in-flight connectivity benchmark

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Airways has significantly expanded its partnership with SpaceX-owned Starlink, equipping over 100 widebody aircraft with Starlink in-flight connectivity and operating up to 200 daily connected flights.

press_references.value: Qatar Airways Privilege Club, QIIB sign enhanced strategic partnership agreement

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Airways (via its Privilege Club loyalty program) and QIIB signed an enhanced strategic partnership to introduce a co-branded banking product that offers expanded Avios earning and point conversion benefits for customers; the agreement was signed by Qatar Airways Group CEO Badr Mohammed Al-Meer and QIIB CEO Dr. Abdulbasit Ahmed Al-Shaibei.

press_references.value: Qatar Airways becomes first-ever Presenting Partner of Ballon d’Or

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Airways announced it will be the first-ever Presenting Partner of the Ballon d’Or ceremony, in partnership with France Football, for the 69th edition on September 22, 2025 in Paris.

press_references.value: Qatar Airways and Accenture embark on AI-powered partnership to set new benchmark in aviation excellence

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Airways and Accenture have announced a strategic partnership to develop and implement AI-powered solutions in aviation, establishing 'AI Skyways' to drive innovation and operational excellence across the Qatar Airways Group.

press_references.value: Kerala family wins Rs 10 lakh compensation after airline denies boarding to infant

legal_proceedings.description: The Ernakulam Consumer Dispute Redressal Commission in Kerala held Qatar Airways liable for deficiency in service and unfair trade practice after it denied boarding to a couple’s children, including a breastfeeding infant, ordering the airline to pay Rs 10 lakh in compensation plus Rs 25,000 in litigation costs.

press_references.value: Consumer Protection Breaches: NCAA slams N5m fine on Qatar Airways

legal_proceedings.description: Nigeria Civil Aviation Authority fined Qatar Airways N5 million for verified consumer-protection regulation breaches and has opened further investigations that may result in additional sanctions.

press_references.value: NCAA warns Qatar Airways over Nigerian passenger rights violations, threatens sanctions

legal_proceedings.description: Nigeria’s Civil Aviation Authority warned Qatar Airways over alleged violations of Nigerian passenger rights and non-compliance with Part 19 consumer protection rules, citing a case involving a detained Nigerian passenger in Doha. The NCAA issued a Letter of Investigation and determinations, said the airline ignored them, and threatened sanctions for continued non-compliance.

press_references.value: Australian women win right to sue Qatar Airways over forced strip-searches

legal_proceedings.description: Five Australian women have won the right to sue Qatar Airways and MATAR over forced strip-searches at Doha's Hamad Airport in 2020, after a court overturned a previous dismissal, allowing the lawsuit to proceed.

press_references.value: India must address tax challenges faced by foreign carriers: IATA DG

legal_proceedings.description: The Directorate General of Goods and Services Tax Intelligence (DGGI) issued show-cause notices to 10 foreign airlines, including Emirates, British Airways, Lufthansa, Singapore Airlines, and Qatar Airways, alleging unpaid goods and services tax of around 10,000 crore INR. The investigation began in August 2023 and involved summoning executives from the Indian branches of these airlines to explain the tax treatment of services provided by their overseas headquarters.

about_short_description.short_description: Qatar Airways is Qatar's national airline that offers top comfort, fine cuisine, and cutting-edge in-flight entertainment.

product.name: Passenger Air Transportation
product.description: Scheduled international passenger flights connecting Qatar with destinations across the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, Africa, Europe, and the Americas, with Economy, Business, and First Class cabins.

product.name: Online Booking and Trip Management
product.description: Website and mobile services for searching and booking flights, checking in, managing reservations, selecting seats, purchasing extras, and receiving travel updates.

product.name: Onboard Travel Experience
product.description: In-flight service combining cabin accommodations, meals and beverages, digital entertainment, and connectivity options across Qatar Airways’ passenger cabins.

product.name: Qsuite
product.description: A Business Class suite product providing private enclosed seating, configurable spaces for couples or groups, and lie-flat accommodation on selected aircraft and routes.

product.name: Privilege Club
product.description: Qatar Airways’ frequent-flyer programme, offering Avios earning and redemption, tier benefits, award flights, upgrades, and Cash + Avios payment options.

product.name: Airport Lounges
product.description: First Class, Business Class, and membership lounges providing seating, food and beverages, work areas, and pre- or post-flight facilities at Hamad International Airport and selected global airports.
